text:
- TOTAL revenue reached £112.6k TW versus £58.2k LW, a WoW gain of 93.7%.
- TOTAL revenue was £47.5k LY, putting TW at 137.2% YoY growth.
- TOTAL units hit 42,286 TW, up 97.3% WoW, while TOTAL orders reached 2,461 TW, up 11.4% WoW.
- LANDMARK FRAME COVENT GARDEN led products at £3,766.40 TW with a 3.3% share of TOTAL revenue, all £3,766.40 incremental WoW.
- LANDMARK FRAME OXFORD STREET posted £3,753.90 TW and a 3.3% share, with LANDMARK FRAME NOTTING HILL at £3,660.00 TW and a 3.2% share, both added entirely WoW.
- LANDMARK FRAME LONDON BRIDGE recorded £3,603.90 TW and LANDMARK FRAME BAKER STREET £3,447.50 TW, with the top five products holding 16.2% of TOTAL revenue TW.
- WHITE HANGING HEART T-LIGHT HOLDER fell £1,203.07 WoW, the largest product decline, followed by DOORMAT KEEP CALM AND COME IN at £712.05 and RED WOOLLY HOTTIE WHITE HEART. at £626.09.
- GINGHAM HEART DECORATION rose 2,054.1% WoW TW.
